_what: Example Lithuanian recall policy, for trying the gate on a real day. Copy the shape into EIS_POLICY; do not commit a real deployment's terms.
_rule: Excluded title term, or a code set entirely inside excluded divisions => drop. Missing title => keep. Otherwise keep when the title contains a recall root. Codes never veto a matching title.
_roots: Lithuanian is heavily inflected, so every term is written as a root and matched as a substring: `valdym` catches valdymo, valdymui, valdymas.
_excluded_divisions: The 21 CPV divisions that cannot contain control-system work. Same list the Latvian side runs, because CPV is European and the classification is the buyer's own.
_overrides: Codes read anyway, wherever their division sits. The first nine are the radar's own list. `72250` was added after the Lithuanian day of 20 Aug 2026 dropped `ADMS SCADA programines irangos prieziuros paslaugos` — SCADA maintenance filed under software services and nothing else. It is wider than the others and wants a decision, not a silent adoption.
